title: Scriptorium
shortDescription: Ink, lamplight, and careful mistakes inhabit the copying desks.
longDescription:
Slanted desks stand in a row beneath broad windows, each with a sand shaker and a capped ink pot. The air smells of paper, lamp oil, and the patient work of putting one good word after another.
An ink blotter on the nearest desk carries a reversed impression of a bird's wing. A trail of blue music notes wanders off the edge of the practice sheet.

fixtures.name: Ink Blotter
fixtures.examineDescription: In the little desk mirror, the blotter's backwards writing becomes readable: 'Lantern wren: three notes, brightest at dusk.' A pencilled arrow says 'Music Loft - compare the melody.' The missing field-guide page was taken to study its song, not to hide it.
